body:
## Summary

Finishes the upstream migration from `self-evolving/literature-template`. PR #17 brought the `.agent` runtime and GitHub infra up to Sepo v0.5.0; this PR ports the remaining **quartz frontend / site layer** while preserving this repo's paper-site customizations.

## Adopted from the template (framework/product evolution)

- Layout can now be an array of placements: `quartz/plugins/loader/config-loader.ts` (+ new `config-loader.test.mjs`), `types.ts`, `quartz-plugins.schema.json`.
- Race-condition-safe link previews: `quartz/components/scripts/popover.inline.ts`.
- Comments rename **giscus → sepoComments**: `SEPO_COMMENTS_*` env, defaults ON with a graceful build-warning when unconfigured, `previewSwitcher` support. New `quartz/util/sepoComments.ts` (+ tests); `Comments.tsx`, `comments.inline.ts`, `quartz.ts` updated.
- `SepoPageTitle.tsx` renders a repo GitHub link when `GITHUB_REPOSITORY` is set.
- Removed the obsolete `quartz/static/giscus/{dark,light}.css` and their CORS wiring in `handlers.js` / `vercel.json` (drawer is now themed via `.sepo-comments` CSS variables).

## Preserved repo customizations

- **Paper-root-index chrome**: `content/index.md` is `type: paper`, so `quartz.ts` keeps `isPaperNote` plus the paper-aware `library-page` / custom `not-index` conditions so the root index renders with full chrome (sidebar, header, graph, backlinks, toolbar).
- **Site identity**: `pageTitle`, `pageTitleSuffix`, and `baseUrl` in `quartz.config.yaml` (and the baseUrl fallback in `quartz.ts`).
- **Section-index graph**: did not adopt the template's `folder.positions.right: []`, so folder listing pages keep their right-rail graph.
- **No landing right-rail hide**: `custom.scss` gains the `.sepo-comments` theming block and mobile search selector but omits the template's `body[data-slug="index"]` block that would hide the paper index's right sidebar.

## Validation

- `tsc --noEmit`
- `npm test` — 76 passing (incl. new `sepoComments` and `config-loader` suites)
- `npx prettier . --check`
- `npm run build` — 97 files emitted; sepo-comments gracefully disabled with `SEPO_COMMENTS_REPO` unset
- Spot-checked built HTML: paper root index and `/ziems2026reflections/` folder page both render the right-rail graph and `doc-page-header`

Closes #16

## AI Review Synthesis > Dual-agent review by **Claude** and **Codex**. > Requested by @lolipopshock. Inline comment posted. Now I'll write the synthesis. This is a single-reviewer synthesis (one review file), no prior inline comments or threads; all findings verified against the current diff. --- ## Summary of PR/Issue This PR finishes the Sepo v0.5 migration that #17 began, porting the remaining **quartz frontend / site layer** from `self-evolving/literature-template` while preserving this repo's paper-site customizations. It renames comments **giscus → sepoComments** (new `SEPO_COMMENTS_*` env contract, default-ON with graceful degradation), adopts **layout-as-array** in the config-loader with group-wrapper hoisting, and rewrites the **link-preview popover** to be race-condition-safe. It also removes the obsolete giscus CSS + CORS wiring and preserves paper-root-index chrome, site identity/baseUrl, and the section-index graph. It fixes a genuinely broken half-state: on `main` today the workflows already emit `SEPO_COMMENTS_*` but `quartz.ts` still reads `GISCUS_*`, so comments are effectively unconfigured until this lands. Closes #16. ## Review Solid, well-documented overlay migration that completes a broken half-state with a matching end-to-end env contract; the two framework changes (layout-array, popover race fix) are genuine improvements, and the build is CI-validated. Nothing blocking — the one substantive item is an ambiguous behavior change (comment drawer on tag pages), plus confirm-intent and CI-coverage notes. | Issue | Severity | Description | | -- | -- | -- | | `sepo-comments` layout condition removed entirely | WARNING | On `main` it was `condition: library-page`; now unconditional, so the comment drawer mounts on `tags/*` and other non-library pages — inconsistent with `doc-page-header` (kept `library-page`) and the graph (moved to `site-page`). | | Comments-knob typos soft-fail to a green build with no comments | WARNING | Invalid `SEPO_COMMENTS_DEFAULT_TAB` or discussions-only `SEPO_COMMENTS_TABS` without IDs now `console.warn` + disable comments instead of hard-failing (fatal only if `SEPO_COMMENTS_ENABLED=true`). Confirm this operator experience is intended. | | Redundant `data-app-host` fallback in `Comments.tsx` | INFO | `appHost ?? "https://comment-api.sepo-preview.xyz"`, but `sepoCommentsAppHost()` always returns a value, so the fallback is dead (harmless, matches runtime default). | | Frontend typecheck + new test suites not CI-enforced | INFO | `Agent / Site Preview` runs `npm run build` only; `test-scripts.yml` is path-gated to `.agent/**`/`.github/**`, so `tsc`, prettier, and both new suites are self-reported for this quartz-only change. | | `sepoComments()` env-glue untested | INFO | The `explicitlyConfigured` warn-vs-throw and `unavailable()` paths — where the "default ON / graceful disable" contract lives — have no coverage (the pure decision logic is well tested). | ## Progress - **Validated by author:** `tsc --noEmit`, `npm test` (76 passing incl. new `sepoComments` + `config-loader` suites), `npx prettier --check`, `npm run build` (97 files); the `Agent / Site Preview` build check passed on CI. - **Reviewer-confirmed positives:** config-loader group-hoisting (whole Flex disappears when all members are desktop-only) is semantically better and test-covered; popover rewrite correctly fixes stale-fetch races, full-URL cache keys, and null-deref/`decodeURIComponent` throws; giscus CSS + CORS wiring removed cleanly with no dangling refs; extracted tab-decision logic has meaningful branch coverage. - **No prior feedback to dedup:** no existing inline comments or review threads on this PR (verified via REST + GraphQL); this is the first review pass (handoff round 3/12). - **Inline comment posted:** one on `quartz.config.yaml:272` covering the `sepo-comments` condition removal. ## Issue Details
`sepo-comments` layout condition removed entirely **Cause:** In `quartz.config.yaml` the graph/`docs-explorer` moved `library-page → site-page` and `doc-page-header` kept `library-page`, but the `sepo-comments` block had `condition: library-page` **deleted** with no replacement. `isSitePage` only excludes `tags/*`, so an unconditional `afterBody` component now renders on tag listing pages and every other non-library page — a change from `main` behavior. **Candidate solutions:** If universal comments are intended, leave as-is. If not, add `condition: site-page` (keeps the drawer off `tags/*`, matching the graph) or restore `condition: library-page` (matches pre-PR behavior). **Comments:** Reads like an incomplete swap rather than a deliberate choice; low blast radius but visible. This is a maintainer intent call, hence the `HUMAN_DECISION` next step. Flagged inline at `quartz.config.yaml:272`.
Comments-knob typos soft-fail to a green build with no comments **Cause:** The new "default ON, degrade gracefully" model routes an invalid `SEPO_COMMENTS_DEFAULT_TAB` or a discussions-only `SEPO_COMMENTS_TABS` without Discussion IDs through `unavailable()` → `console.warn` + comments disabled, instead of a hard build error. It only becomes fatal when `SEPO_COMMENTS_ENABLED=true` is set explicitly. **Candidate solutions:** Confirm soft-fail is the intended operator experience; optionally elevate specific typo cases (e.g., an unrecognized `DEFAULT_TAB`) to a build warning that is more visible, or document the degrade behavior. The hard-fail cases (malformed `repo`, bad `SEPO_PREVIEW_PR`) are correctly preserved. **Comments:** Internally consistent design; the risk is a green build silently shipping without comments. Judgment call, not a defect.
Redundant `data-app-host` fallback in `Comments.tsx` **Cause:** `data-app-host={opts.options.appHost ?? "https://comment-api.sepo-preview.xyz"}`, but `sepoCommentsAppHost()` in `quartz.ts` always resolves a value (same default), so `appHost` is never nullish here. **Candidate solutions:** Optional — drop the `??` fallback, or keep it as defensive matching of the runtime default. Harmless either way.
Frontend typecheck + new test suites not CI-enforced **Cause:** `deploy.yml` is `workflow_dispatch`-only and `test-scripts.yml` is path-gated to `.agent/**` + `.github/**`, so a quartz-only change runs neither `npm run check` (tsc + prettier) nor `npm test`. The passing check (`Agent / Site Preview`) runs `npm run build` only. **Candidate solutions:** Optionally add quartz source paths and an `npm test` / `npm run check` step to `test-scripts.yml` so frontend regressions are caught automatically. Out of scope for this PR unless the maintainer wants it bundled.
`sepoComments()` env-glue untested **Cause:** `sepoComments.test.ts` covers the pure tab/default-tab decision logic well, but the `explicitlyConfigured` warn-vs-throw branching and `unavailable()` disable paths in `quartz.ts` — the actual "default ON / graceful disable" contract — have no tests. **Candidate solutions:** Optionally extract the warn-vs-throw decision into a pure helper and cover it, mirroring the existing extraction pattern. Low risk; the glue is thin.
## Recommended Next Step `HUMAN_DECISION` — the one substantive finding (comment drawer now rendering on `tags/*`) is an ambiguous intent question that needs a maintainer choice; the remaining items are confirm-intent or optional coverage notes, none safe for an automated guess at the intended behavior. ## Final Verdict `MINOR_ISSUES` ## Action Items - [ ] Decide whether `sepo-comments` should render on tag/non-library pages; if not intended, add `condition: site-page` (or restore `condition: library-page`) to the `sepo-comments` layout in `quartz.config.yaml`. - [ ] Confirm the comments soft-fail behavior (typo'd `SEPO_COMMENTS_*` knobs → green build, no comments) is the intended operator experience. --- `claude` | `claude-opus-4-8` | `max` | `GitHub Actions 1000014575`
